speech_query_preprocess.note: void Preprocess(IQueryPreprocessor* this, SpeechQuery* q): the speech registry's per-event 'pre' handler (slot 0 of the interface at object+0x40, vtable 0x1497BE0A0; the object's primary vtable is 0x1497BDFD0). Runs for every CommentaryDb event the game plays (registry dispatch 0x1407AFD88) or asks about (HasAudio 0x1444F340C), under the registry lock. Sets cm_sim = (speech parameter IS_CAREER_MODE_SIM == 1), then for every query parameter whose name contains '_pID' with a value > 0 sets the twin '_gID' (player_db_pID -> player_db_gID) = gender map[value] (1 when the player is not in the map; not set at all while the map is null), and for team_type 1/2 sets team_gID / opposite_team_gID from the team pair. THE hook point for in-match remaps (docs/re/inmatch-callnames.md section 4)
